faqs.q: Sec. 102-43. - Fees and user charges not to affect bond ordinances.
faqs.a:
System development charges and user charges established in this article do not supersede
               those established by existing bond ordinances wherein such fees and charges are established.
               Nothing herein contained shall void or otherwise make unenforceable any surcharges
               established by prior ordinances, nor restrict the future adoption of ordinances establishing
               surcharges where applicable.
(Code 1981, § 33-12; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 4819, § 10, 10-17-2022,
               eff. 7-1-2023)
